**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/06/15 (Thu) 19:19
- [USER] User asked about the meaning of "I'll know."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "I'll know" is a contraction of "I will know."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The phrase means that the speaker will have knowledge or information about something in the future.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The phrase can indicate confidence or certainty that the speaker will recognize or identify something or that they will have learned something by a certain point in time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Example provided: "I'll know if the package has arrived when I see it on the doorstep."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Another example provided: "After I study for the exam, I'll know all the answers."
